input_units.membrane_index: integer index 0 to 3 of calibrated membrane
input_units.feed_fraction: mol H2 per mol feed, fraction
input_units.normal_flow_L_min: normal L min^-1; assumed 22.414 L mol^-1

timing_contract: Known membrane, inert gas, temperature, feed fraction, absolute pressures, normal feed flow and specimen geometry only; no mixture flux or held-out pure-hydrogen response.
calibration: All models have the declared 64 pure-hydrogen measurements at 350/450 C through frozen pressure/permeance calibration. No 400 C calibration was available during fitting. Normal molar volume 22.414 L/mol is a stated convention.
independent_unit: complete inert-gas block at reserved 400 C across the four calibrated membranes

attempt-004.equation: J=P_m(T)*[max(p_r*xbar(J)-J/k,p_p)^n_m-p_p^n_m]; xbar=(x-z/2)/(1-z/2); z=J*A/Fmol; k=K_m*G_g*(F/5)^0.6*(T/673.15)^1.75; numerical pressures are absolute bar; Fmol=F/(60*22.414). Positive bounded root.

mean.equation: Jhat=development mixture mean for the calibrated membrane.

sieverts.equation: J0=P_m(T)*max((x*p_r/bar)^n_m-(p_p/bar)^n_m,0), with frozen pure-hydrogen Arrhenius calibration; n=0.5 for Sieverts.

richardson.equation: J0=P_m(T)*max((x*p_r/bar)^n_m-(p_p/bar)^n_m,0), with frozen pure-hydrogen Arrhenius calibration; n=0.5 for Sieverts.

rbf.equation: Jhat=J0*exp(clip(sum_i w_i exp(-||standardize(X)-center_i||^2/(2*h^2)),-3,3)); all calibration, scaling, centers and weights frozen.

rbf_nested.equation: Jhat=J0*exp(clip(sum_i w_i exp(-||standardize(X)-center_i||^2/(2*h^2)),-3,3)); all calibration, scaling, centers and weights frozen.

uncertainty_policy.reason: Show every complete reserved group. Within-system and temporal dependence, few condition blocks or calibrated sites limit population-level claims; no row-bootstrap confidence interval is claimed.

scope_limits: Sixty mixture observations in three gas blocks at 400 C, on four previously calibrated membranes. Temperature interpolation in these systems, not independent new-specimen or separator transfer.

exposure.historical_record: All reference confirmation targets are exposed. This is a retrospective diagnostic evaluation, not fresh independent confirmation.

historical_metric_corrections: F1 uses2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); zero on nonempty total failure. Historical reports unchanged.
